notes.title: Habilis braces for winter sale with a fine tuning.
notes.notes:
Increased lighting to dark areas.
Attempted to fix issue with windowed mode,
Fixed issue with v-sync causing mouse issues. (if you still have this issue make sure to toggle v-sync.
Adjusted some overlapping audio.
Adjusted audio overall.
Slight reduce of footstep sounds

notes.title: Some updates including speedrun functionality for full version
notes.notes:
Fixed bug with windowed resolution 
Fixed two text errors in tutorial
Changed to names in credits
Fixed colliders with crates in second level
Speed run functionality in full version

notes.title: A new ending!
notes.notes:
[b]I just reworked the ending to Habilis[/b], after watching a lot of people play I feel like it was a bit too abrupt.
It needed more of a finalized conclusion for Nathan. I think it's much better now. Also special thanks to my kid for help with the idea.

I also fixed a saving bug in level 3 that made you get stuck.

Thanks guys! I do listen to feedback and apply it.

-Seth

notes.title: Voice audio slider added
notes.notes:
There is now a slider in the audio options to adjust voice volume, so you can get it appropriate for your own preference.

Also added a link to mother hub in game cause why not
